subject.title: Nix: speed up gateway builds and enforce cache-only CI consumers

question: Should maintainers rebase the remaining source-builder `mv` optimization onto current main, or close this branch as superseded by the current gateway packaging split?
rationale: Current main already includes the safety and `dontFixup` pieces, but the remaining install-semantic change is compatibility-sensitive and the member-authored PR is conflicting, so automation should not choose the packaging direction.

options.title: Rebase narrowly
options.body: Preserve current `dist-runtime`, plugin manifest, bundled skills/templates, cleanup, symlink validation, and wrapper-default behavior while applying any still-wanted move optimization.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: If the source-builder move optimization is no longer worth carrying after the npm-shrinkwrap default path, close the stale branch manually.

recommendation.title: Rebase narrowly
recommendation.body: Preserve current `dist-runtime`, plugin manifest, bundled skills/templates, cleanup, symlink validation, and wrapper-default behavior while applying any still-wanted move optimization.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the trim commit and recent overlapping gateway packaging changes, making them the best available routing owner for the rebase-or-close choice.
